coverage_limits: Annual values were assembled from the browser-rendered original SEC 10-K disclosures. This snapshot does not demonstrate a live SEC API run.
Amounts are in USD millions except ratios, per-share amounts and aircraft units. The exact share count is converted to millions for the model.
Issuer free cash flow is cash from operations less cash capex. It is kept separate from modeled free cash flow to equity.
Aircraft manufacturing revenue per delivery is a blended implied metric. Standalone custom-completion revenue and transaction-level aircraft prices are unavailable.
The dated year-end share price is supplied separately by the market input packet.
